content: Godot 4.7.2-stable (2026-08-18) is the newest patch of the current stable branch; 4.7 shipped 2026-06-18, 4.7.1 on 2026-07-14, 4.8 is only beta2 (2026-10-29). Godot has NO 4.x LTS: per the official release policy, LTS status is only granted to the previous major branch when a new major ships (currently 3.6 is the 3.x LTS). Therefore the LTS-vs-latest question does not apply to Godot 4; pin the newest patch of the current stable branch. 4.6.3 stays supported until 4.8 ships, after which it drops to partial support.
